# Campaign 39: frozen regression evidence

`campaign39.json.gz` contains eleven real records and their saved original
pages, validated AI responses (including partial responses), discovery queries,
and historical browser observations. Extracted read-only from the local archive
on 19 October 2026. No new web requests, inferred facts, credentials or provider
keys. Public business contacts are evidence, not consent to send messages.

Record IDs: 330, 332, 334, 342, 359, 369, 395, 398, 420, 449, 485.
The replay uses the first original-page AI output, before historical repairs.
It does not replace failed browser measurements or invent missing originals.
Synthetic tests are explicitly marked separately from these acquired cases.

## Campaign 40: owner and territory regressions

`campaign40.json.gz` contains saved original HTML from tasks 5197, 5359 and
5311 (records 556, 736 and 678). Repeated URLs are stored once. The acquired
pages, timestamps and historical identity/triage decisions come from the
read-only campaign snapshot dated 20 October 2026. No new requests or AI
outputs were generated. Public business contacts remain acquisition evidence,
not authorization to contact anyone.

SHA-256: `d86a6977a659b2ebe2c701e71b882b49e9e33d06624431da0995fb9dc5752406`.

The replay exercises the real site-identity and pre-audit triage functions.
Cartoveneta may become eligible for measurement, not a qualified opportunity.
The company portal and public health authority must not be audited as small
manufacturers. Synthetic negative controls cover incidental customer/portal
mentions, service areas and conflicting office addresses.

## Campaign 40: browser diagnostics

`browser40.json.gz` contains the four historical browser reports, including
phase diagnostics and observations, from the same read-only snapshot. It does
not contain downloaded resource bodies and cannot replay the sites' rendering.
The reports remain partial in tests; no successful viewport is invented from
them. `tests/browser91_harness.py` instead uses explicitly synthetic resource
latency and real local Chromium to verify recovery and fault isolation.

## Campaign 40: query and invitation direction

`commercial40.json.gz` contains 52 observed search receipts, 89 saved plan
proposals and five original records (566, 657, 564, 499, 738), with their
acquired text and validated citations. Replays do not call a model or search
provider. They compare explicit requested roles and query policies, not new
qualifications. Tests separately mark synthetic valid developer requests for
franchise, tourism and sales platforms, which must remain eligible.
